name: Egypt
sources: $43bn on the World Bank's series and 58.4m people.

Mubarak's Egypt is the second-largest recipient of US aid after Israel, and its debt is crushing — external debt alone is 79% of GNI on the eve of the Paris Club write-off it earned by joining the coalition.
A modest producer: 0.87 mbd from the Gulf of Suez and the Western Desert.
